description: Send a contact card (vCard) to a WhatsApp number.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to send this contact card.

contact_phone.description: Phone number on the contact card

phone.description: WhatsApp number in international format without + (e.g. 201234567890), or the contact's phone / chat_id as listed by get_conversations_awaiting_reply (website chat, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram…)

name: send_contact_card
